notes.text: Aleksander Barkov is on long-term injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 12 games. He is one of their best players.
Brad Marchand is on injured reserve (leg injury) and has missed the last 10 games. He is a top-six forward.
Cooper Black was added to the roster on Oct 21.
Cole Reinhardt was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Eetu Luostarinen and Anton Lundell.

Rasmus Sandin is out long term and has missed the last 9 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Timothy Liljegren has taken his spot beside Martin Fehérváry. That pair has had 38% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 53:54 together.
Jack St. Ivany joined from WPG on Oct 25 and has played beside Cole Hutson.
Jakob Chychrun has started killing penalties: on the ice for 26% of the team’s shorthanded time in 13 games, up from 8% last season.

story.head: The matchup inside the matchup
paras: The Capitals (8-5-0) lost 5-1 to Minnesota on Sunday, while the Panthers have won three straight. Going in, the Panthers are fifth in the Atlantic (tied for eighth in the NHL) and the Capitals third in the Metropolitan (tied for 17th).

The Panthers forecheck harder than anyone (1st), rarely ice the puck (1st) and hit a lot (1st). As for the Capitals, they have had some of the league’s best goaltending (3rd) and get their shots through to the net (5th). They also get the league’s best looks (1st), so their good looks will be harder to come by against the Panthers. The Cats’ power play (5th) could do real damage against the Capitals’ penalty kill (26th).

Matthew Tkachuk (4 G / 16 A / 20 P in 14 GP) leads the Panthers in scoring, and Brady Tkachuk (8 G / 7 A / 15 P in 14 GP) has a team-high eight goals. Alex Tuch (10 G / 2 A / 12 P in 13 GP) is tied for the Capitals’ scoring lead, with a point in five straight games against Florida. Dylan Strome (3 G / 9 A / 12 P in 13 GP) shares it.

Akira Schmid (5-2-1 / .888 SV% in 7 GS) will likely start for Florida. Washington has two options in net: Logan Thompson (5-4-0 / .898 SV% in 9 GS) and Charlie Lindgren (3-1-0 / .888 SV% in 4 GS). Thompson has started seven of their last ten games, including the last one on Sunday, so Washington could turn to Lindgren to give him a rest. It’s anyone’s guess who gets the net.
At home, Spencer Carbery likes to send Protas, Dubois and Wilson out against the other team’s top line, so watch for them against Verhaeghe, Reinhart and Vilmanis.

items.text: The Panthers have been without Jacob Markström, Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand for several games. Akira Schmid is expected to start.
Tom Wilson has a point in six straight games against Florida.
The Capitals have been without Rasmus Sandin for several games.
Carter Verhaeghe has eight goals on chances worth about 4.5 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
